item.text:
Implemented configurable topic backlinks. New posts and edits now synchronize references, add timeline events linking to the referencing post, and remove events when links are removed. The admin switch controls whether backlink events appear.

Verification passed: 192 topic tests, 100 post tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.
